subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Miscellaneous runtime objects and helpers without a shared subsystem home: growable string tables and quoted-token parsing, AI command-response and state-flag handling, session timer scaling and setup-value formatting, brake-temperature fade physics, settings-path enumeration, camera object lifecycle, spatial-tree traversal and collision broad-phase helpers.

summary: A mixed set of runtime objects recovered from 25 functions: a growable key/value string table with capacity growth and teardown (0x00423530) plus a quoted-token parser that feeds its builder (0x004236F0); an AI command-response handler that dispatches dequeued command IDs to state/parameter setters (0x00429EE0) with a per-state flag-table getter (0x0042AE90) and a global state-flag inversion helper (0x00435240); a session timer scalar writing a global (0x0042BDA0); a 2D lookup-table ratio calculator (0x0042DD00); three vehicle setup-value formatters sharing a format flag and unit-string/suffix layout (0x0042F180, 0x0042F1E0, 0x0042F260); a brake temperature fade force model (0x00430A50) and a single-step torque-force product step (0x00438100); settings path building and directory enumeration (0x00432180, 0x004326D0, 0x00432870) plus a double-pointer teardown helper (0x00434420); a camera object initializer (0x004348B0); an object constructor with Direct3D state init (0x00448120), a noise-table scalar (0x00448300) and a record midpoint helper (0x00448480); spatial tree node counting and linearization (0x004486A0, 0x004486E0); and collision broad-phase, stream-fed triangle building and BSP material selection (0x004497E0, 0x00449F60, 0x0044A4B0). Class ownership is GUESS for most clusters; only the string table, ratio calculator and camera object carry DERIVED owner hints from the packet, and several objects are left as UnknownObject.

function_roles.role: Insertion into a growable key/value string table with capacity growth by 128 slots and old-buffer teardown.
Quoted-token parsing of an input string into two output buffers, feeding the string-table builder called alongside InsertKeyValuePairWithAutoGrow.
Dispatch of dequeued AI command IDs (0, 4, 5, 14) to side-effect setters, gated by race-phase and session-type globals.
Read-only per-state flag/selector table lookup driven by the selector field at this+0x4588.
Scales a double timer input by 400.0 and stores the truncated integer into the session-timer global.
Weighted 2D lookup-table ratio computation with row/column bounds guards and 0.0 sentinels.
Formats a scaled setup value as "%d %s" with optional degree-conversion factor.
Formats one setup value with a float ("%.1f %s") or integer ("%d %s") branch selected by the format flag.
Formats a setup value with an optional indexed offset term and a metric/inches ("%.1f %s" / "%.3f %s") branch.
Brake temperature fade force model with compound-specific constants, axle temperature blends and per-wheel fade sampling.
Builds and persists a settings-file directory path then enumerates files under the search path.
Thin wrapper forwarding the enumerator pointer at this+0 to DirectoryFileEnumerator.
Combines three path strings from a string-pointer array, defaulting null entries to the default application directory.
Destructor-style teardown of a double-pointer object gated by the flag byte at this+8.
Allocates and configures a 208-byte camera/transform object and runs post-init camera setup.
Boolean helper returning the logical negation of StateFlagCheck evaluated on the global flag value.
Single-step torque-force product accumulation into vehicle dynamics fields.
Object constructor zeroing this+4 and initializing Direct3D rendering state.
Produces a scaled value from a lookup table indexed by a monotonically incrementing global counter.
Unconditional element-wise midpoint (0.5 scale) of two three-field records into the output record.
Recursive node count of a spatial tree over a four-child array at +0x4C and an extra child at +0x5C.
Recursive linearization of a spatial tree into a contiguous output array, recording each node's output index at +0x48.
Sweep-and-prune broad-phase AABB overlap detection over a triangle batch, marking overlapping pairs.
Builds a triangle work set from a 34-byte stream record and packed vertex indices into a caller vertex array.
Recursive collision-material selection for a vertex region with arena output and half-region recursion.

classes.name: GrowableStringTable
classes.responsibility: Growable key/value string table: 3-dword header (capacity at +0x0, count at +0x4, entries pointer at +0x8) with growth by 128 slots; entries are 16-byte {char*, int, char*, int} records.

classes.name: AIDriverCommandState
classes.responsibility: AI driver command-response state: reset flag, driver status and AI state flag updated when dequeued AI command IDs are dispatched; behavior gated by race-phase and session-type globals.

classes.name: AIDriverStateFlags
classes.responsibility: Per-state flag/selector table lookup: reads a selector at +0x4588 and indexes an embedded dword table (base dword index 1113).

classes.name: SessionTimerScaler
classes.responsibility: Scales a double timer input by 400.0 and stores the truncated integer into the session-timer global dword_7C5694.

classes.name: RatioCalculator
classes.responsibility: 2D lookup-table ratio computation: row/column counts and 8-byte entry arrays, divisor and scale; returns a weighted ratio or 0.0 on any guard failure.

classes.name: SetupValueFormatter
classes.responsibility: Formats vehicle setup values into caller buffers with float/integer and metric/inches variants, an optional indexed offset term, and unit-suffix strings; shared format flag at +0x4.

classes.name: VehicleBrakeFadeState
classes.responsibility: Brake temperature fade force model inputs: compound index at +0xBC4, front/rear axle brake temperature/scale/wear triples and per-wheel fade fields.

classes.name: SettingsFileScanner
classes.responsibility: Builds a settings-file directory path (sanitized base plus subdirectory and trailing backslash), persists it into global buffers, and enumerates files under a search path.

classes.name: DirectoryEnumeratorWrapper
classes.responsibility: Thin wrapper forwarding an enumerator pointer held at this+0 to DirectoryFileEnumerator with a literal 0 argument.

classes.name: PathStringCombinator
classes.responsibility: Combines three path strings from a string-pointer array (elements 0, 2, 4), substituting the default application directory string for null entries.

classes.name: DoublePointerOwner
classes.responsibility: Small object owning a double pointer; flag-gated teardown frees the inner allocation first, then the outer pointer.

classes.name: CameraObject
classes.responsibility: Camera/transform object: allocation of a 208-byte object stored at +0xC, float camera parameter configuration, name assignment ('gridwalkcam'), vtable-driven post-init and track-spline setup.

classes.name: VehicleDynamicsState
classes.responsibility: Vehicle dynamics force-accumulation fields; the torque-force product step reads inputs at +0x364/+0x36C and writes the intermediate +0x374 and accumulated +0x22C outputs.

classes.name: D3DStateContainer
classes.responsibility: Object whose constructor zeroes field +4 and initializes Direct3D rendering state via D3DStateInit.

classes.name: RandomNoiseSource
classes.responsibility: Produces a scaled value by indexing a noise lookup table with a monotonically incrementing global counter; scale factor at +0x8, output slot at +0x14.

classes.name: RecordMidpointHelper
classes.responsibility: Element-wise midpoint of two records (float at +0x0, double at +0x4, float at +0xC), each scaled by 0.5; returns the first source pointer.

classes.name: SpatialTreeNode
classes.responsibility: Spatial tree node with a four-child pointer array at +0x4C, an extra child at +0x5C, and a linearization output index at +0x48.

classes.name: CollisionBatchBroadphase
classes.responsibility: Collision triangle batch (count at +0x0, 32-byte-strided triangle array at +0x8) with sweep-and-prune AABB overlap marking of triangle pairs.

classes.name: IndexedCollisionBodyBuilder
classes.responsibility: Builds a triangle work set from a 34-byte stream record and packed vertex indices, copying 16-byte vertex records from a caller vertex array.

classes.name: BspMaterialSelector
classes.responsibility: Recursive collision-material selection for a vertex region: writes classification and dispatch-index words at +0x8/+0xA, reserves arena output at +0xC, and recurses over two child half-regions.

state_machines.name: AIDriverCommandDispatch
transitions: On dequeued command ID 0 found (session type global != 7): clear reset flag at +0x4544, set parameter 18, set driver status 5, set AI speed delta 1
On command ID 5 found: set parameter 99999, set reset flag 1
On command ID 4 found: set AI state flag at +0x443C to 1, set parameter 18
On command ID 14 found: clear reset flag, set AI state flag 1
When race-phase global dword_7C56A8 == 3: session-cleanup block (clear flags, wrap player callback)
When race-phase global dword_7C56A8 == 4: reset AI speed delta to 0, set parameter 99999, set reset flag 1

interfaces.name: AiCommandSideEffects
interfaces.purpose: Side-effect setters dispatched by the AI command-response handler: command search, parameter/status/speed setters and session-cleanup wrappers.

interfaces.name: StringBufferLifecycle
interfaces.purpose: Heap string duplication and allocation/free lifecycle helpers shared by the string table, path building and teardown paths.

interfaces.name: PathAndStringScanHelpers
interfaces.purpose: Path building and truncation, delimiter scanning and directory enumeration utilities used by settings and path construction.

interfaces.name: NumericAndSortHelpers
interfaces.purpose: CRT conversion, trigonometric-style float scaling and sort helpers.

interfaces.name: StreamAndFormatHelpers
interfaces.purpose: Stream read dispatch, conditional dispatch and bounded string formatting helpers.

interfaces.name: StateAndSessionLookup
interfaces.purpose: State-flag checks and session-state indexed lookup.

interfaces.name: VehicleModelLookup
interfaces.purpose: Tire-brand and compound-index lookup, wheel-force aggregation and parameterized curve interpolation used by the brake-fade model.

interfaces.name: CollisionGeometryHelpers
interfaces.purpose: Collision-body initialization, SAT edge separation, polygon surface fitting, spatial-hash key generation, coverage scoring and material lookup.

interfaces.name: CameraTransformHelpers
interfaces.purpose: Camera/transform object initialization, track-spline extrapolation, shutdown and post-init helpers.

compatibility_contracts.name: GrowableStringTableInsert
compatibility_contracts.description: InsertKeyValuePairWithAutoGrow returns 0 on success and -1 when the key or value is null, empty, or the two strings are equal. Growth allocates capacity+128 entries with a 4-byte header and an empty-entry convention {0, -1, 0, -1}; entries are 16-byte key/value records whose strings are duplicated through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, and the old buffer is freed.

compatibility_contracts.name: StringTokenParse
compatibility_contracts.description: Parses quoted tokens from an input string into two caller buffers; returns 0 on success and -1 on null/empty input or when the period separator is absent. Output buffers are zero-initialized and null-terminated.

compatibility_contracts.name: AiCommandResponse
compatibility_contracts.description: Processing a dequeued AI command mutates driver-state fields: reset flag at +0x4544, driver status at +0x4510 and AI state flag at +0x443C. Behavior is gated by the race-phase global (3: session cleanup; 4: speed-delta reset) and the session-type global (!= 7 for command-0 handling).

compatibility_contracts.name: SetupValueFormatting
compatibility_contracts.description: Setup values are formatted as "%d %s", "%.1f %s" or "%.3f %s" into buffer a2+30 with unit-suffix strings and optional radian-to-degree (5.710147155067049) and metric-to-inches (0.3937007874015748) conversions selected by the format flag at +0x4.

compatibility_contracts.name: BrakeTemperatureFade
compatibility_contracts.description: ComputeBrakeTemperatureFade returns (v29 - v26 * a2^2) / v33, where v33 is a normalized brake force, v26 a front-axle temperature blend and v29 a wheel-loop fade ceiling. Requires TireBrandLookup and CompoundIndexLookup to succeed and returns 0 on any guard failure.

compatibility_contracts.name: SettingsPathBuild
compatibility_contracts.description: Settings file discovery builds a sanitized path, appends a subdirectory component and a trailing backslash, persists the result into global buffers via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and enumerates the directory; returns 1 unconditionally.

compatibility_contracts.name: CameraObjectInit
compatibility_contracts.description: CameraObjectInit allocates a 208-byte transform/camera object, stores it at +0xC, sets float parameters (+0x38, +0x3C, +0x48, +0xA4, +0xA8), assigns the name 'gridwalkcam', and returns 0 on success or 1 when allocation or track-spline setup fails.

compatibility_contracts.name: SweepAndPruneBroadphase
compatibility_contracts.description: SweepAndPruneAABBOverlapDetection allocates a 20-byte-per-entry projection buffer, sorts entries by left bound, and marks overlapping triangle pairs with a 1 byte at triangle+24 after SAT edge-separation validation.

unresolved: The three setup-value formatters (0x0042F180, 0x0042F1E0, 0x0042F260) are grouped as one SetupValueFormatter class, but they read their unit-suffix strings from different this offsets (+56, +72, +24 respectively); common ownership is GUESS, not proven.

StringHashTokenParsing's this+1/this+2 offsets are character positions within the parsed input string, not object fields; no owning class is proposed, and the token-parser relationship to InsertKeyValuePairWithAutoGrow (both called by 0x00423890) is unproven.

InsertKeyValuePairWithAutoGrow's 16-byte entry layout {char*, int, char*, int} and the {0, -1, 0, -1} empty-entry convention are DERIVED readings, not independently confirmed; the three StringCopyWithBufferRealloc calls in the growth path discard their results.
The meaning of the growth step 128 and the role of the 4-byte header word in the string table are source facts whose structural semantics are not confirmed.
AI command IDs 0/4/5/14 and the magic parameter values 18/99999 depend on ParameterValueSetter's parameter table, which is outside this packet.
Race-phase constants 3 and 4 in dword_7C56A8 and the session-type inequality 7 in dword_7C56A4 are asserted by prior analysis but not proven here.
The dword table returned by StateFlagsLookup (base dword index 1113) has unknown length and element semantics; only the selector field at +0x4588 is captured.
The exact side effect of sub_5895A2 and whether dword_7C5694 is a timer or angle output are not documented.
RatioCalculator's +0 base / +4 weight meaning within each 8-byte table entry is inferred from the ratio formula, not independently evidenced.
The 5.710147155067049 (degree) and 0.3937007874015748 (inches) conversion factors are inferred, not grounded in unit definitions.
SetupValueFormatWithOffset's offset-term fields 0xC70/0xC78/0xC84/0x199C belong to an unidentified owning class; only their use in the indexed offset term is evidenced.

ComputeBrakeTemperatureFade's compound-struct fields at v4+32..+452 and polynomial coefficients v36..v39 are read but have no field evidence; the meaning of return denominator v33 and clamp constant v40 is unconfirmed.
SettingsSetupFileRead references global byte_7CE498 (labeled AutoLoadConfigFile) in packet facts, but the global does not appear in the raw source text; its role is unverifiable.
DirectoryFileEnumeratorWrapper's literal second argument 0 and its cluster_copy pairing with ConditionalFreeWithBit0Flag (0x00404F70) are DERIVED and unverified.
PathStringCombinator's exact semantics of sub_5665B0 and StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, and the ownership of the returned pointer, are unresolved.
DoublePointerFree's byte at +8 is unknown (ownership flag vs reference count); the structural twin DestructorWithDoubleFreePattern (0x00418D60) is DERIVED.
CameraObjectInit's float fields (+0x38/+0x3C/+0x48/+0xA4/+0xA8) have no established semantic meaning (FOV/scale/near/far).
TorqueForceProductComputation's outputs at +0x22C/+0x374 are recalculated every frame per the persistence note, so external pokes do not persist.
ObjectConstructor's zeroed field at +4 is either an initialization flag or reference counter; the object type is unidentified.
RandomScaledValue's lookup table at 0x008AAE74 and counter at 0x008AAE70 (trig/weather noise) are DERIVED from existing analysis, not independently proven.
WeightedAverageInterpolation's float/double split of the 0.5 constant between flt_59E450 and dbl_59E880 is DERIVED; the caller record type is unidentified.
DynamicsNodeCountRecursive and BVHTreeLinearize assume recursion on the same node pointer; child-pointer slots 0x50/0x54/0x58 have no packet evidence; no depth bound or cycle protection is evidenced.
SweepAndPruneAABBOverlapDetection's projection axes are inferred from the SAT test context; the owning collision triangle structure is unidentified.
IndexedVertexLookupFromStream's interpretation of a2+52/a2+56 as vertex count/record-array base is DERIVED; FileWriteWithBackendDispatch being used to read stream bytes is unproven.
BspLeafMaterialSelectionAndSubdivision's arena record layout, the sub_44A2D0 coverage-score semantics, and the float-encoded vertex-list-head pointer in a2 are Hex-Rays artifacts.

The packet lists double constants 0x59E420/0x59E430/0x59E880, 0x59EA58..0x59EA80 and dword_8AD254 for ComputeBrakeTemperatureFade, but several do not appear as named operands in the raw source text; exact roles unresolved.
